delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm god-function gates for _apply_plan_tickets in src/koru/autonomy/todo2code_discovery.py (fan-out 11->5, mutations 25->3, CC 7->3) by extracting the per-plan loop body into _file_plan_ticket and _record_plan_dispatch and by returning NamedTuples (_RankedPlans, _ExistingPlanTickets, _PlanIdentity, _PlanDispatch) from the ranking, dedupe-identity, plan-identity and dispatch helpers, while preserving identical usefulness filtering, deduplication identities, ticket-limit accounting, create_nl_task arguments and the (created, skipped, useful_count, filtered_out_count) return tuple.
nonGoals: Refactoring the other god-flagged functions in this module (separate planfile tickets)
Changing plan usefulness scoring, ranking order or priority mapping
Altering task creation arguments, labels or executor scaffold fields
Extracting code into a new module (patch targets must stay module-local)

architecture.decision: Keep the pipeline in one module: split per-plan filing (scaffold + identity + dedupe skip) from dispatch bookkeeping (created/skipped append and dedupe-set growth), and replace multi-value tuple returns with NamedTuples so the orchestrator reads fields instead of unpacking.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the inline _apply_plan_tickets loop with tuple-returning helpers.

validation.evidence: Cyclomatic complexity of _apply_plan_tickets and all touched helpers stays at Rank A/B; fan-out and mutation counts re-measured below the code2llm gates (fan-out<=10, mutations<=6).
